picks.why: colored view of the walled town below Monte Urgull with the bay and Santa Clara island; single strip, no gutter

picks.what: View from the Loyola side, lithograph in Galería Militar Contemporánea
picks.why: the rebuilt town under Monte Urgull with the bay and Igueldo; right edge trimmed to remove a red library stamp

picks.what: La Concha beach, photochrom print (Library of Congress)
picks.why: color view of La Concha beach and its promenade; the LOC public-domain copy of the same print as #9

picks.what: Aerial photograph of La Concha Bay from Monte Igueldo (Dirección General de Turismo archive)

classic view of the bay with Santa Clara island, Monte Urgull and the city; very high resolution

notes: #1 (Rijksmuseum copy of the 1572 view) is an album sheet with a large hand-painted sky added above the view; the Heidelberg copy #4 chosen instead. #2, #3 and #6 are full plates or text pages shared with Burgos. #13 is Cádiz (seen from its San Sebastián lighthouse) and #19 is San Sebastián de La Gomera, both excluded. #18 is a duplicate photochrom. #7 is low resolution (1200 px) but the only view between 1572 and the 1890s.
